Le Podcast du Weekend est une production: Le Podcast du Weekend is a France Inter production offering a weekly selection of reports, interviews and columns from the station. A showcase format for public radio, betting on a variety of topics and quality production to keep listeners company at weekends.
Une chronique de 3 minutes de Martin Bro: A 3-minute column by Martin Broyer, broadcast every Saturday morning on France Inter. In a few minutes, he makes you want to explore a podcast you'd never have listened to on your own, with original and often surprising subjects. Very well produced, with a journalistic tone that guarantees editorial quality. Our verdict: a sweet treat that won't give you diabetes. "3 minutes of listening on Saturday morning over breakfast — I approve and recommend." — Lolo
